name: pegasus-cortex-client
description: Guidance for bounded Codex continuity through the existing shared Pegasus Cortex MCP connection and admitted offline CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Recover and retain bounded local context.
interface.longDescription: Teaches use of the existing shared Pegasus Cortex MCP connection: one compact 4 KiB start per exact task, optional phase identity, preview-first geometric retrieval over explicit project/knowledge spaces, batched exact reads, agent-side revision reuse, meaningful updates, atomic closeout, and task-scoped offline fallback. This skills-only plugin declares no MCP server or automatic startup.
defaultPrompt: Start meaningful work once in compact format with the exact CODEX_THREAD_ID, explicit namespaces, 4 KiB, and an optional stable phaseId.
Treat search hits as previews; exact-read selected records in batches and reuse loaded revisions only while their full bodies remain in agent context.
Checkpoint meaningful project task state; route reusable learning to knowledge.shared and local user guidance to knowledge.user only when explicitly selected.
